opening.argument: The presentation promotes downloading a cryptocurrency trading bot while advertising unusually high returns. Its title claims “+70% Profit Per Week,” and the description says the bot can earn “over 30% per day” in a growing market. It directs viewers to a download and instructs them to send trading funds and purchased tokens into a contract rather than keeping them in the wallet. That combination of extraordinary return claims, bot installation, and contract-based handling of funds supports deceptive solicitation. The records do not establish that the claimed returns occurred or that the contract caused a loss. Nor do the login step or visible GitHub wording independently establish credential misuse or authorized endorsement.
